answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the vertex is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution.
